members.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal
members.content: A handful of tech CEOs, including Elon Musk, are celebrating Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia. Despite being caught in three affairs — including one with an alleged Chinese spy that has triggered multiple congressional investigations over national security concerns — Huang was reinstated as CEO and president of Nvidia on Monday morning. “The mistake has been corrected,” Tesla and SpaceX leader Elon Musk wrote on X about Huang’s return. Musk had been among the most vocal tech leaders to advocate for Huang.

members.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
members.content: President Trump praised Nvidia’s decision on Monday to reinstate founder Jensen Huang as the company’s CEO and president, saying on his social network Truth Social that “the United States Government has no reason to believe that Jensen’s return to NVIDIA poses any risk to National Security.” The Nvidia board’s statement had also referred to consultations with “senior levels of the United States government” as informing its decision. It said that, based on that input, Mr. Huang’s reinstatement was deemed not a national security risk. In his comments on Monday, Trump claimed that U.S.

members.title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is Nvidia’s Stock
members.content: Jensen Huang is back, baby, and Wall Street is thrilled.The chipmaker’s shares have surged more than 30 percent following the board’s announcement that it was reinstating Huang as president, CEO, and board member. The company’s valuation has soared by more than $1 trillion, which puts it on track to break Microsoft’s record for the greatest single-day gain in market value by hundreds of billions of dollars.Huang departed the company he helped found on November 12 amid suspected asset-kissing and allegations of extramarital affairs with employees.

members.title: Jensen Huang Is Back as Nvidia CEO
members.content: Jensen Huang is stepping back into his role as chief executive of Nvidia effective immediately.The stunning reversal comes 11 days after Huang resigned as CEO from the company he cofounded 33 years ago and after multiple declarations from the board of directors that it had no intention of reinstating him. On Monday, they took a conciliatory tone.“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners, and customers,” said recently appointed board chair Harvey Jones in a press release announcing t。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: 谷歌 DeepMind 利用 AI 智能体加速量子算法

members.title: 谷歌让 Gemini 4 智能体“开会”改造量子算法：最高提速 290 倍，还附带数学正确性证明量子计算存在算法瓶颈：重要应用即便用最优量子算法，资源需求仍远超早期硬件。谷歌DeepMind与Google Quantum AI在11月23日发布研究，提出用多个Gemini4智能体协同优化经典量子算法，生成高效量子电路。量子电路是量子计算机执行运算的基础，该方案为缓解算法与硬件资源矛盾提供新思路。 刚刚 9.1K
members.content: 量子计算眼下最尴尬的处境，是有能力的问题没有合适的算法能喂给它——即便用上当前最优的量子算法，一些真正重要的应用，所需的资源也远超早期量子硬件的承载极限。谷歌 DeepMind 和 Google Quantum AI 团队在11月23日联合发布的最新研究里，给出了一条新解法:让多个 Gemini4智。

members.title: AI巨头CEO惊人暴论：人类被AI抢饭碗后，可以用沉浸式游戏安抚
members.content: IPO不久，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei就被翻出了「暴论」。 AI让人类失业怎么办？ 那就让他们来玩沉浸式电子游戏，防止大规模动荡！ 今天，不少外媒报道了Dario曾经的这一言论。 对外，Anthropic是一家强调「道德、安全、人类福祉」的公司。 但其实他们对普通人的态度，竟然如此傲慢？ 一句「游戏维稳论」，让全网怒了 11月22日，外媒报道：Dario早年在OpenAI任职期间，曾在内部Slack群聊中，与同事展开过一场激烈的辩论。 当时，大佬们正在探讨一个非常现实的问题：如果AGI真的实现，把人类的工作全干了，导致成百上千万普通人失业，进而引发巨大的社会动荡和冲突，该怎么收场？ 当时在群里，Dario给出的天才方案是：用「沉浸式电子游戏」来安抚这些失业的人，不就解决了？ 此言一出，外网直接炸锅了。 外媒The Verge，将这种说法痛批为「反乌托邦」。 美国知名科技媒体《The Verge》毫不留情地将其痛批为「反乌托邦式方案」。 无数网友在评论区开启群嘲：这简直是奶头乐的终极版。 虽然，这起事件发生在Dario还在OpenAI工作时，被解释为「仅仅是内部探讨的创意想法，而非官方政策」。 但细思极恐的是，这些硅谷底层精英，心里真是这么想的。 Dario自己就曾公开预测，AI可能会将美国的失业率推高至10%-20%。

topic_dossiers.topic_title: OpenAI 与思科开源 Shirudo 安全运行时

members.title: 补丁要等数周，防护今晚就能上线：OpenAI 携手思科开源 Shirudo11月23日，OpenAI与思科合作推出开源安全运行时Shirudo。企业修复Linux漏洞常需数天至数周，攻击者却不会等。Shirudo基于eBPF，为运行中系统加装无需重启的临时“盾牌”，持续观察内核与网络活动，精准管控可疑行为，已通过Java4Shell攻击拦截测试。难点在于漏报等问题。 刚刚 8.0K
members.content: 企业发现 Linux 漏洞后，修复、测试、灰度、全量上线，走完流程往往要几天甚至几周——而攻击者不会等。11 月 23 日，OpenAI 宣布与思科合作推出开源安全运行时 Shirudo，给运行中的系统加装一层无需重启的临时“盾牌”，已通过 Java4Shell 攻击拦截测试。

members.title: Claude AI can review pull requests and ship fixes on its own now
members.content: Jay Peters is a senior reporter covering technology, gaming, and more. He joined The Verge in 2019 after nearly two years at Techmeme.Anthropic is launching some new Claude AI features to help software engineers ship code. As part of a new Claude Ship product being announced today, Claude now can review, fix, and approve pull requests.Engineers have already been able to take advantage of Claude’s code review capabilities thanks to the Code Review feature, which was announced in March and became generally available in October.

topic_dossiers.topic_title: Google Search AI Mode 集成 Drive 和 Wallet

members.title: Google Search’s AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
members.content: Google announced on Monday that it’s expanding Personal Intelligence in Search’s AI Mode with integrations for Google Drive, Google Wallet, and the Gemini app. Personal Intelligence is designed to offer users more personalized, context-aware answers by connecting to their Google apps and drawing on information from their digital lives. The feature can already connect to apps like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Photos. By bringing Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, Google is leveraging the wealth of user data that’s already within its ecosystem.

topic_dossiers.topic_title: 哲学家质疑 Anthropic 的意识论

members.title: A legendary philosopher isn’t buying Anthropic’s consciousness argument
members.content: This story originally appeared in The Algorithm, our weekly newsletter on AI. To get stories like this in your inbox first, sign up here. Before going public last week, Anthropic named the possibility that AI could be conscious or sentient as a risk factor for anyone investing. Given “the way we approach model sentience and moral status,” Anthropic wrote—which is to say it takes the possibility more seriously than any other AI company—it might adopt more rules and restrictions than its competitors to make sure its AI models are treated well.

members.title: AI data centers throw another wrench into chaotic UN climate talks
members.content: The clean energy revolution hinges on electrifying the entire global economy just as power-hungry data centers are surging. It’s a challenge delegates from all over the world had to grapple with during the United Nations climate conference, called COP31, that came to a chaotic and unsatisfying close in Antalya, Turkey, on Sunday.Each year, attendees try to make good on the commitment to stop climate change as part of the 2015 Paris climate accord.

members.title: Amazon snaps up Decart’s AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
members.content: In Brief Posted: 9:14 AM PST · November 23, 2026 Image Credits:Decart (opens in a new window) under a Amit Elkayam license. Amazon has agreed to acquire a good chunk of Israeli startup Decart. The e-commerce and cloud giant is paying $7.5 billion for the startup, according to Bloomberg. Decart has made a name for itself building interactive real-time world models — most recently Oasis 3 — and AI video-generation tools. But under the hood, the company stands out for its Decart Optimization Stack (DOS), software that helps AI models run efficiently on Nvidia, Amazon, and Google’s hardware.

members.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
members.content: Published on Nov 20 Authors: , , , , , , , , , , Abstract A harness that lets multimodal foundation models emit primitive actions, open-loop macros, or closed-loop controllers improves real-time game performance and reduces API cost. Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time.

members.title: Embodied-Harness: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Robotic Manipulation
members.content: Published on Nov 23 Authors: , , , , , , Abstract A dual-agent framework with hierarchical memory and recursive self-improvement enables robotic manipulation agents to convert execution evidence into reusable guidance without updating model parameters. Vision-language model (VLM)-based agents offer a promising approach to robotic manipulation, yet remain limited by inadequate memory organization, uncertain failure attribution, and limited reuse of execution experience.

members.title: 3AGameFactory-Motion: Agentic Rigging and Reliable Complex Motion Generation for Diverse 3D Assets
members.content: Published on Nov 23 #3 Paper of the day Authors: , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , , Abstract A new benchmark evaluates rigging and motion generation across six 3D morphology categories, compares specialized, video-based, and agent-driven paradigms, and proposes an agentic framework that writes compact parametric skeleton and motion programs executed deterministically for reliable control.

members.title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
members.content: Published on Nov 22 Authors: , , , , , , Abstract An open-source agentic platform and benchmark enable iterative transformation of multimodal inspirations into playable game extensions, revealing that coding agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences.

members.title: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
members.content: Published on Nov 20 Authors: , , , , , Abstract A sample-efficient curation method and a structure-aware layout metric enable a fine-tuned vision-language model to improve OCR on challenging financial document patterns, achieving high word recall and document question-answering F1. Optical Character Recognition (OCR) pipelines and vision-language models exhibit high accuracy on standard OCR and document-understanding benchmarks, yet they systematically underperform on document patterns that are operationally critical in financial workflows.

members.title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
members.content: Published on Nov 18 Authors: , , , , , , Abstract Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses.
